description: This file contains implementations of dot product and average power functions for complex float types, utilizing SIMD optimizations, within the ocuduvec namespace.

methods.name: dot_prod(span<const cf_t> x, span<const cf_t> y)
methods.description: Calculates the dot product of two complex float spans, using SIMD if available.

methods.name: dot_prod(span<const cbf16_t> x, span<const cf_t> y)
methods.description: Calculates the dot product between a span of cbf16_t and cf_t, using SIMD if available.

methods.name: dot_prod(span<const cf_t> x, span<const cbf16_t> y)
methods.description: Calculates the dot product between a span of cf_t and cbf16_t, returning the conjugate of the previous.

methods.description: Calculates the average power of a span of complex floats.
